title.rendered: Nearshore Services for Outcome-Driven Software Development

content.rendered:
There are many talks around nearshore services and how this outsourcing approach can add to the quality of developed software and the comfort of cooperation. Let’s dive into details of what are the specifics of hiring a nearshore IT outsourcing company and what outcome-driven results one can get by using the nearshoring model of hiring developers.

The Rising Demand for Nearshore IT Services

In short, nearshore outsource process is about delegating some tasks to a service provider located in a neighboring country. Nearshoring means that the vendor is located in close proximity to your country so it facilitates good communication, similar cultural background, and eliminates language barriers.

Nearshore IT services are in high demand nowadays because of the convenience of communicating with the development team in terms of time zones, language, cultural similarities, among others. Some of the companies that use nearshore IT outsourcing services include Viber, CurrencyCloud, Unity Technologies, Mapp Digital, and so on.

The biggest concern of nearshore services newcomers is managing offshore development teams, so let’s explore the advantages and disadvantages of this outsourcing model.

Pros and Cons of Nearshore IT Outsourcing

Before choosing any hiring model, it is important for the company to analyze its benefits and drawbacks. By properly investigating these aspects, the company may prevent potential pitfalls and guarantee successful cooperation.

  • Optimal time zone

Probably, the main advantage is that both you and the nearshore outsourcing company are located in the same time zones. Thus, you are assured in effective communication through the day and easy monitoring of the project’s progress.

  • Fast hiring process

A nearshoring vendor usually delivers a shortlist of candidates within 2-3 weeks, while for you to find qualified personnel takes around 4-5 weeks. Moreover, in the hiring process, you will be able to conduct personal interviews with the candidates to make sure you know everything about them.

  • Large talent pool

If you face a scarcity of talents in a specific technology, the nearshoring model allows you to open a great pool of professionals across the world.

  • Minimum language barriers

For instance, most software developers in East Europe possess at least an upper-intermediate level of English so problem-solving situations as well as working discussions can be handled at ease.

  • Cultural similarities

By hiring a nearshore outsourcing services company, you won’t have to worry about significant cultural differences. Therefore, you will have common business views, and finding a compromise in troubleshooting situations might be handled in a timely manner.

  • The bigger RoI

Thanks to the geographical proximity, almost no time zone difference, as well as minimal cultural and language barriers, a nearshore IT outsourcing company comes as the most profitable partner to work with. By turning to nearshore services, you are eliminating a bunch of dangers associated with hiring an outsourcing firm.

However, besides the undoubtful nearshore outsourcing benefits, there are some challenges that come with cooperating with a nearshore service provider, including:

  • Offshore outsourcing can still be cheaper

Unfortunately, although in terms of quality, opting for nearshore services can be your best bet, the rates of some Asian or Indian outsourcing companies may still be lower. However, taking into account the convenience of working with a software development company located in a neighboring country, the cost is worth it.

  • Fewer nearshore IT services providers

When you limit your search for geographical proximity of the software development outsourcing provides, you get a shorter pool of talents to choose from. However, it doesn’t necessarily mean that you won’t find remarkable nearshore outsourcing examples among IT companies near the border.

How to Choose a Reliable Nearshore IT Outsourcing Company

When choosing a reliable nearshore outsourcing company, you need to keep in mind a set of requirements and characteristics of your service provider. Here are the features of a trustworthy and reliable nearshore IT outsourcing company:

If the company has been on the market for at least 5 years and build a strong image of a reliable service provider with many positive reviews, such a firm is probably worth cooperating with. Moreover, if the company has already worked on the projects within your industry, the chances that they can find and build your development team are higher.

Nearshore Services in Different Countries: Stats and Numbers

Besides the quality of the provided services, the location of the firm also influences the final cost of working with a nearshore IT company. The graph below demonstrates the difference in the rate of salary an average software developer earns in the indicated countries:

  • Poland – $39,807
  • Switzerland – $87,804
  • Germany – $58,018
  • The Czech Republic – $42,501
  • Ukraine – $25,084

As you can see, despite being one of the countries with the most skilled specialists not only in Europe but the whole world, Ukrainian nearshore firms charge the lowest rates.  Due to the benefits of the country’s location and expertise of Ukrainian programmers, Ukraine is a highly popular nearshore choice for many foreign businesses located within Europe.

Why Nearshoring to Ukraine Is Beneficial

Building the nearshore center in Ukraine is the best option to find qualified software development. As you can see from the above, Ukraine is one of the most suitable destinations for companies looking for nearshore solutions not only in terms of reliability but also cost-effectiveness.

Thanks to the vast talent pool, solid programmers’ expertise, their good command of English, dedicated approach to work, and convenient location of the country on the map of Europe, Ukraine comes as a perfect destination for creating a nearshore IT center for your company or finding an expert nearshore company for hire here.
